hook: Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found
hookText: Credit card skimming scripts using WebRTC found

beats.say: Researchers found credit-card skimming scripts on popular shopping sites that steal payment data and send it out over WebRTC, a channel that slips past many blocklists.
Lascana replied to us and removed the Quorum pixel from their site by November 24th at 15:48 UTC.
Only step 4 is an ordinary web request, which a connect-src rule can block; steps 5 to 7 run over the WebRTC data channel, outside connect-src.
